records.jp: うわっ、高……
records.en_original: Whoa, that's a pretty good drop...
records.en_auxiliary: Whoa, that's a pretty good drop...
records.en: Whoa, that's high...

records.jp: 下、見えないね
records.en_original: Can't even see the bottom.
records.en_auxiliary: Can't even see the bottom.
records.en: Can't even see the bottom.

records.jp: あの後のこと、何か思い出せそう？
records.en_original: Have you remembered anything after the previous memory?
records.en_auxiliary: Have you remembered anything after the previous memory?
records.en: Can you remember anything that happened after that?

records.jp: うん
records.en_original: Yeah.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah.
records.en: Yeah.

records.jp: あの後？
records.en_original: The previous memory?
records.en_auxiliary: The previous memory?
records.en: After what?

records.jp: 改めて説明した方がよさそうだね
records.en_original: Maybe we should explain.
records.en_auxiliary: Maybe we should explain.
records.en: It sounds like we should explain again.

records.jp: えっとね、ココロトープを回って、<CR>いろんなことを思い出したんだ
records.en_original: Um, well, as we've walked around the Heartscape, I've been able to remember some things.
records.en_auxiliary: Um, well, as we've walked around the Heartscape, I've been able to remember some things.
records.en: Well, we have been exploring the Heartscape<CR>and remembering all kinds of things.

records.jp: 私たちには、女手一つで育ててくれたお母さんが<CR>いたこと
records.en_original: That we were raised by a single mother.
records.en_auxiliary: That we were raised by a single mother.
records.en: That we had a mother who raised us<CR>all by herself.

records.jp: そんなお母さんが、電球を買いに行くって言って、<CR>帰ってこなくなっちゃったこと
records.en_original: And that one day, after telling us she was going out to do errands, she disappeared.
records.en_auxiliary: And that one day, after telling us she was going out to do errands, she disappeared.
records.en: That Mom went out to buy a light bulb<CR>and never came home.

records.jp: 大きくなった私たちが、お母さんを探そうとしたこと
records.en_original: When we got older, we decided that we'd look for her.
records.en_auxiliary: When we got older, we decided that we'd look for her.
records.en: That when we got older, we tried to find Mom.

records.jp: そんな時に、詩ちゃんに会って……<CR>お母さんの居場所を教えられたこと
records.en_original: Then, we met Uta... She told us where Mom was.
records.en_auxiliary: Then, we met Uta... She told us where Mom was.
records.en: That while we were looking, we met Uta-chan...<CR>and she told us where Mom was.

records.en_original: Uta Komagawa...
records.en_auxiliary: Uta Komagawa...
records.en: Komagawa Uta...

records.jp: 思い出した。<CR>たしかにそんなことがあったわ
records.en_original: Yes, I remember now.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes, I remember now.
records.en: I remember.<CR>That certainly happened.

records.jp: 半信半疑、だったけど……<CR>でも、調べないわけにはいかなかった
records.en_original: We had our doubts, but we still went to investigate.
records.en_auxiliary: We had our doubts, but we still went to investigate.
records.en: We were skeptical,<CR>but we could not simply ignore it.

records.jp: お母さんがいなくなってから何年も経ってたからね。<CR>手がかり自体少なかったんだ
records.en_original: It had been so long since Mom disappeared, we didn't have many leads.
records.en_auxiliary: It had been so long since Mom disappeared, we didn't have many leads.
records.en: Years had passed since Mom disappeared,<CR>so we had very few leads.

records.jp: だから必死に探した。リフレクターの仲間にも、<CR>いろいろと手伝ってもらって……
records.en_original: We were desperate. We asked Reflectors who would listen for their help.
records.en_auxiliary: We were desperate. We asked Reflectors who would listen for their help.
records.en: We searched desperately. Our fellow Reflectors<CR>helped us in many ways...

records.jp: ……そうだ。わたしも、その時手伝っていたのです
records.en_original: ...That's right! I remember helping you.
records.en_auxiliary: ...That's right! I remember helping you.
records.en: That's right. I helped you then too.

records.jp: そして、ようやくお母さんの居場所を見つけた
records.en_original: And we finally found where our mom was.
records.en_auxiliary: And we finally found where our mom was.
records.en: And finally, we found where Mom was.

records.jp: でも――
records.en_original: But—
records.en_auxiliary: But—
records.en: But—

records.jp: 来ないで
records.en_original: Don't come any closer.
records.en_auxiliary: Don't come any closer.
records.en: Don't come any closer.

records.en_original: Huh...?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh...?
records.en: Huh...?

records.jp: な、なんで……？　お母さん……
records.en_original: Mom... Why...?
records.en_auxiliary: Mom... Why...?
records.en: W-why...? Mom...

records.jp: 私には、あなたたちに会う資格なんてない……
records.en_original: I don't have the right to see either of you.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't have the right to see either of you.
records.en: I don't have the right to see either of you.

records.jp: 帰って。これ以上話すことはないから――
records.en_original: Go home. I have nothing else to say to you.
records.en_auxiliary: Go home. I have nothing else to say to you.
records.en: Go home. I have nothing else to say to you.

records.jp: 会う資格がない、か……
records.en_original: What does "the right to see you" mean...?
records.en_auxiliary: What does "the right to see you" mean...?
records.en: "I have no right to see you"...

records.jp: そんな……せっかく再会できたのに……
records.en_original: How terrible... After you worked so hard to find her...
records.en_auxiliary: How terrible... After you worked so hard to find her...
records.en: How terrible... After you worked so hard to find her...

records.jp: それで私たちも、<CR>どうすればいいか分からなくなっちゃって……
records.en_original: After that, we had no idea what to do anymore.
records.en_auxiliary: After that, we had no idea what to do anymore.
records.en: And then we had no idea<CR>what we were supposed to do...

records.jp: 陽桜莉さん……
records.en_original: Hiori...
records.en_auxiliary: Hiori...
records.en: Hiori-san...

records.jp: ……記憶を取り戻すって、<CR>嬉しいことばっかりじゃないよね
records.en_original: Memories aren't always happy.
records.en_auxiliary: Memories aren't always happy.
records.en: ...Getting your memories back<CR>isn't always a happy thing, is it?

records.jp: ……うん。辛いことも、悲しいことも、<CR>全部含めて私たちの思い出だよ
records.en_original: Yes. Some can be sad, or painful. But all of those memories together make us who we are.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes. Some can be sad, or painful. But all of those memories together make us who we are.
records.en: ...No. The painful and sad ones too—<CR>all of them are our memories.

records.jp: 私も、そう思うわ
records.en_original: I believe so too.
records.en_auxiliary: I believe so too.
records.en: I believe so too.

records.jp: 私は……どんな思い出も失いたいとは思わない。<CR>過ちも、後悔も、全部が今の私を形作ってるから
records.en_original: No matter how painful the memory, I don't want to lose it. I wouldn't be myself without them.
records.en_auxiliary: No matter how painful the memory, I don't want to lose it. I wouldn't be myself without them.
records.en: I... do not want to lose any of my memories.<CR>My mistakes and regrets all shaped who I am now.

records.jp: お姉ちゃん……
records.en_original: Mio...
records.en_auxiliary: Mio...
records.en: Onee-chan...

records.jp: 雨、降ってきそうだね
records.en_original: Looks like it's going to rain soon.
records.en_auxiliary: Looks like it's going to rain soon.
records.en: It looks like rain.
